newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenia's prime minister Bagratyan resigns.
newsitem.headline: Armenia's prime minister Bagratyan resigns.

text.p: Armenian Prime Minister Grant Bagratyan announced on Monday he was resigning for personal reasons after more than three years in office.
"This is my decision. I will not be working in government service any more. I shall be living in Yerevan and writing a book," the 38-year-old politician said, without giving any other details.

Bagratyan, appointed by President Levon Ter-Petrosyan early in 1993, is credited with putting Armenia's economy on the road to recovery despite a partial blockade of its trade routes linked to its conflict with Azerbaijan over Nagorno-Karabakh.
Political sources said his successor was likely to be Armenia's ambassador in London Armen Sarkisyan.
